title: Engineered wood products.
officialText:
Cuts, notches and holes bored in trusses, structural composite veneer lumber, structural glue-
laminated members and I-joists are prohibited except where permitted by the manufacturer’s recommendations or where the effects
of such alterations are specifically considered in the design of the member.
